summary: First sftd GA built by this repository's pipeline. It brings the reworked Helm chart of 5.1.0, which is not out yet and will follow from release/5.1, plus the audio and video fixes for selective forwarding that Jenkins shipped in 5.0.99 and 5.0.100. Coming from a 5.0.x build, follow the 'Before upgrading' section of the 5.1.0 release note first. The chart is published to the charts-avs Helm repository again, as well as to oci://quay.io/wire/charts/stable/sftd.

changes.description: Audio stream selection: a new speaker takes a free stream before taking over an active one, and only takes over a speaker who is quieter by a clear margin. This stops two speakers of similar level from alternating on the same stream, which garbled the audio. Streams whose sender has stopped for more than a second are freed, new participants start at silence instead of the loudest level, federated participants are compared with their own audio level instead of a level shared by the whole remote SFT, and a participant leaving no longer resets the streams of another call.

Audio no longer becomes very delayed after a stream has been unused for a while: when a new source takes over a stream, its timestamps follow the time that has actually passed, so the receiver's jitter buffer does not grow.
In federated calls, video forwarding no longer uses uninitialised SSRCs when the sending participant is not found.

Releases prepared from dev publish the chart to the charts-avs Helm repository again, as well as to oci://quay.io/wire/charts/stable/sftd (oci://quay.io/wire/charts/dev/sftd for pre-releases), and pin it in wire-builds. The 5.1.0 pre-releases went to the OCI repository only.
